facts.fact: a new Solidify modifier has thickness 0.01, offset -1, rim on, even thickness off
Solidify offset -1 grows the shell behind the normal (z from -0.1 to 0), 0 centres it, +1 grows along the normal
a solidified plane is closed and manifold with the rim on
with use_rim off, the two shells are not joined (open boundary)
on a box corner, Solidify's corner vertices move by thickness*sqrt(2) along the averaged normal without even thickness; use_even_offset keeps the walls at the set thickness
a new Bevel modifier: width 0.1, segments 1, affect EDGES, limit_method ANGLE at 30 deg, clamp overlap on
Bevel on a cube: (verts, faces) by segments
Bevel profile 0.5 is round, 1.0 pushes the profile out to the original corner (square), 0.0 pulls it in (concave): nearest-vertex distance to the original corner
on a size-2 cube, Bevel width 1.5 (more than half an edge): with use_clamp_overlap the width is clamped and no face turns inside out; without it, faces invert
on a 32-sided cylinder, Bevel's default ANGLE limit bevels only the two rims; limit_method NONE also bevels the 32 side edges
an evaluated mesh obtained before a change is freed when the depsgraph re-evaluates: touching it raises ReferenceError
facts.error: ReferenceError: StructRNA of type Mesh has been removed

facts.fact: limit_method WEIGHT bevels only edges with a bevel_weight_edge attribute value > 0
